findings.title: Mileage reimbursement POST declares no security
findings.evidence: "security":[] on the operation, while every other write endpoint requires oauth2 scopes; the only response is a 401 Unauthorized.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the empty security override or set it to oauth2 with reimbursements:write, matching sibling endpoints.

findings.title: Card vault POST returns sensitive data with a generic 201 mismatch
findings.evidence: Summary says 'Create a spend limit and retrieve sensitive card details' but the response is PCILimit containing a card with PAN and CVV, and the path name 'vault' gives no hint of this; the 201 response is the only success code.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the summary to reflect the spend limit and PAN/CVV return, and document that sensitive fields are returned in the response.

findings.title: Card vault schema contradicts itself on expiration and cvv
findings.evidence: expiration is marked readOnly but listed as required, and 'cvv' and 'pan' are optional strings with no indication of when they are populated.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify which fields are populated by which endpoint and make the required list consistent with readOnly semantics.

findings.title: Physical card GET uses 201 instead of 200
findings.evidence: Responses define "201": {"description":"Success"} for a GET, while other GETs return 200.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the success response code to 200.

findings.title: Virtual card GET summary says permanently delete
findings.evidence: Summary is "Permanently delete this resource" on a GET operation that only returns the card with 200.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the summary to 'Fetch a virtual card'.

findings.title: Physical card POST error response is untyped string
findings.evidence: 400 response has content schema {"type":"string"} with description 'Error', unlike other endpoints using DeveloperApiErrorResponse; no x-trace-id header.
findings.suggested_fix: Use DeveloperApiErrorResponse and the x-trace-id header as other endpoints do.

findings.title: Physical card PATCH and POST suspension lack error responses
findings.evidence: Only a 200 response is declared; the GET and POST operations on the same resource document 400 CardInvalidInput.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the 400 DeveloperApiErrorResponse (and 404 where applicable) to every operation.

findings.title: Two different tag names for transactions
findings.evidence: Top-level tags include both 'Transaction' and lowercase 'transactions' with no description; the PATCH operation uses tags ["Transaction","transactions"].
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicate lowercase 'transactions' tag and use only 'Transaction'.

findings.title: Inconsistent naming for the user filter parameter
findings.evidence: Parameter 'userId' is camelCase while all other query params (user_id, entity_id, page_size) are snake_case.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to user_id, keeping userId as a deprecated alias if needed.

findings.title: Inconsistent sort parameter naming
findings.evidence: orderByAmountAsc is camelCase while order_by_amount_desc and order_by_date_asc are snake_case.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to order_by_amount_asc.

findings.title: Reimbursement user_id filter parameter has no description
findings.evidence: The user_id parameter at the end of the list has no description, unlike all neighbouring filters.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a description, e.g. 'Filter reimbursements by the user who submitted them'.

findings.title: Transaction state filter and enum conflict
findings.evidence: Description says if state is not set all transactions except declined are returned, but the description for ALL is a 'special filter value'; the enum includes ALL in the Transaction.state response schema too, which is not a real transaction state.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove ALL from the response schema enum and document it only as a filter value.

findings.title: Virtual card list pagination cursor ambiguity
findings.evidence: start is described as 'the ID of the last entity of the previous page', but page_size declares a 2-100 range without any schema minimum/maximum, and the physical cards list has no pagination params at all.
findings.suggested_fix: Add minimum 2 and maximum 100 to page_size schema and document start consistently across list endpoints.

findings.title: Physical card list has no pagination parameters
findings.evidence: Description says 'Returns a paginated list' and the response is PaginatedResponseApiPhysicalCardResource, but no start or page_size parameter is declared.
findings.suggested_fix: Declare start and page_size query parameters matching the other list endpoints.

findings.title: Pagination 'next' is an unusable placeholder
findings.evidence: Examples show next as 'https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1/<resources>?<new_params>', a literal template rather than a URL, and the format is described only as '<BASE_URL>?<new_params>'.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide a realistic example and document that clients should follow next verbatim.

findings.title: Transaction amount field is deprecated but still typed as number
findings.evidence: amount is type number while the same field in SingleTransaction is type string; the two response schemas disagree.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the type consistent across Transaction and SingleTransaction, or remove the deprecated field.

findings.title: Min/max amount filters accept string or number
findings.evidence: Schema uses oneOf of decimal string and number, and the description does not specify units or precision.
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one type (string decimal) and document units in dollars.

findings.title: Mileage distance schema uses oneOf without a clear type
findings.evidence: distance is declared as oneOf of decimal string and number with no description of units; distance_units is a separate enum without a default.
findings.suggested_fix: Choose a single numeric type and make distance_units required when distance is set.

findings.title: Reimbursement create requires line-amount validation not documented
findings.evidence: spend_allocation_id is nullable and named differently from fund_id used elsewhere, and the request has no description of the response semantics.
findings.suggested_fix: Document that spend_allocation_id maps to fund_id and add field descriptions.

findings.title: Transaction split PATCH has no description of unsplit or the response code
findings.evidence: Marked x-destructive true, but there is no documented idempotency behaviour; 'create or replace' split semantics mean repeated calls overwrite data, and no 4xx errors are documented.
findings.suggested_fix: Document overwrite semantics, idempotency, and error responses for the PATCH operation.

findings.title: Idempotency key defined inconsistently across endpoints
findings.location: POST /developer/v1/cards/vault header X-Idempotency-Key and POST /developer/v1/reimbursement/submit-receipt body idempotency_key
findings.evidence: Vault creation uses an optional X-Idempotency-Key header, while receipt upload requires a body field idempotency_key; no other POST endpoints (physical card create, mileage reimbursement) accept any idempotency control.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one mechanism (preferably the header) consistently and document which POSTs are idempotent.

findings.title: Reimbursement receipt upload path is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Path uses singular 'reimbursement' while all other reimbursement paths use plural '/reimbursements/'; it also uses hyphens while others are underscored or single words.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to /developer/v1/reimbursements/receipts or similar.

findings.title: Transaction-related reimbursement list uses inconsistent date parameters
findings.evidence: to_transaction_date description is just 'Data.' while from_transaction_date says 'after this date'; from_date and to_date are documented as created dates, and inclusive/exclusive bounds are not stated.
findings.suggested_fix: Give each date filter a real description including whether bounds are inclusive.

findings.title: Placeholder descriptions on several parameters
findings.evidence: Descriptions 'Data.' appear on include_merchant_data for transaction fetch and on to_transaction_date, which convey no meaning.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace placeholder text with accurate descriptions.

findings.title: Two 'amount' fields with different types and meanings
findings.evidence: The transaction schema has deprecated amount (number), entity_amount (signed, nullable), and merchant_amount; the create/update code path mixes minor units (split line items) and decimal amounts in examples (amount: 90.0).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the deprecated amount field and document units clearly for every amount.

findings.title: Vault creation spending_restrictions bypass policy on spend_program_id
findings.evidence: Description says if spend_program_id is passed, spending_restrictions is ignored, but both are optional and no validation rule is stated.
findings.suggested_fix: State the precedence explicitly and specify the error returned when both are sent.

findings.title: Physical card fund_id and auto-routing conflict is not enforced in schema
findings.evidence: Description says if automatic_routing_enabled is True, fund_id cannot be set, and the example sets both automatic_routing_enabled false and fund_id, yet there is no oneOf or mutual exclusion encoded in the schema.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the conflict as an explicit 400 error and add it to the error responses.
